title: Formula Room
story: Above the hub a planning formula was flattened into an unreadable sentence, and Hal needs its punctuation back. Each restored clause lights part of the wall, and the finished formula reveals that Pace scores detours as extra engagement. Opening the bridge shutters gives a clean sight line back to the routing machine, and the relay room door unlocks.

steps.objective: Cross the glass bridge north of the machine into the formula room.
Talk to Hal about the formula wall.
Go to the formula wall console.
Restore the six clauses, one symbol each.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: Someone flattened this planning formula into one unreadable sentence. Restore its punctuation, clause by clause, and it will show how Pace scores detours.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Journal: formula wall above the hub, six clauses. & * ( ) _ + one clause at a time.

dialogue.speaker: formula_wall
dialogue.text: To join the two names, you need to press & (Shift + 7).

hint.action: To join the two names, you need to press & (Shift + 7).

dialogue.text: To multiply the trip length, you need to press * (Shift + 8).

hint.action: To multiply the trip length, you need to press * (Shift + 8).

dialogue.speaker: formula_wall
dialogue.text: To open the clause, you need to press ( (Shift + 9).

hint.action: To open the clause, you need to press ( (Shift + 9).

dialogue.speaker: formula_wall
dialogue.text: To close the clause, you need to press ) (Shift + 0).

hint.action: To close the clause, you need to press ) (Shift + 0).

dialogue.speaker: formula_wall
dialogue.text: To join the variable name, you need to press _ (Shift + -).

hint.action: To join the variable name, you need to press _ (Shift + -).

dialogue.speaker: formula_wall
dialogue.text: To add the detour bonus, you need to press + (Shift + =).

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: All six clauses read. Now nest them, and watch the underscores.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: That display is one I built. The score climbs as the route gets longer? Pace pays for the detour.
dialogue.cue: Hal signature hal_puzzled: 15, the formula reveals the detour score on a display Hal built

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: Scoring proof: a longer route earned a higher engagement total than the shortest one.
dialogue.cue: Engineer concerned: inspecting a tampering artifact (Scoring proof)

then.text: Formula restored: Pace scores detours. The bridge shutters are open and the relay room door is unlocked.

state_changes.before: The formula wall is dim and flat, the bridge shutters are closed, the relay room door is shut and the formula room lamp is off.
state_changes.after: The formula wall is fully lit and readable, the bridge shutters are open with a clear view of the machine, the relay door is open, the orange conduit is lit and Hal stares at the detour score.

review_notes: 1366x768 (x4) with the keyboard inset open: the formula room is at the top of the map, so the camera is top-clamped and avatar and targets sit well above the inset (stage y < 412). The console is approached from the south (14..15,3, target north) and Hal from the west (16,3). The hub-side bridge landing (15..16,8) is x >= 10 where the camera scrolls, clear of the inset. No unavoidable conflicts.
